source: Dhan historical REST API (read-only) via DhanHistoricalBarProvider + historical_client.py

provenance_policy.research_eligibility_rule: domain.market_data.provenance.is_research_eligible() - only REAL_DHAN rows are research-eligible; UNKNOWN and SYNTHETIC_TEST are excluded
provenance_policy.note: REAL_DHAN provenance is stamped on every bar this provider returns, including bars belonging to a PARTIAL session. PARTIAL sessions are real Dhan data but are excluded from the 'trusted/COMPLETE dataset' definition below - REAL_DHAN row count and 'trusted dataset' row count are two distinct numbers, see completeness_requirement.

completeness_requirement.definition: A (symbol, date, timeframe) session is COMPLETE only when every expected bar-close timestamp computed by HistoricalDataCoverageService (application/services/historical_data_coverage.py, read-only, unmodified) is actually present in the database. Sessions with any missing expected timestamp are PARTIAL and excluded from the trusted dataset.
completeness_requirement.no_fill_policy: No missing bar was interpolated, filled, or synthesized at any point in this checkpoint.

session_regime_coverage.note: All 10 requested sessions fall on/after CAS_EFFECTIVE_DATE (2026-08-03, domain/session/calendar.py) - all new ingestion this checkpoint is CAS_ERA. Pre-existing REAL_DHAN rows (ADANIPORTS/RELIANCE 5m, 2026-07-29/07-30, from a prior checkpoint) remain the dataset's only PRE_CAS REAL_DHAN coverage.

ingestion_method.idempotency: HistoricalDataCoverageService.get_coverage() checked per symbol against the full requested window before any Dhan request; only the reported missing_ranges were fetched.

known_deferred_issues: 358-vs-360-bar discrepancy (not investigated this checkpoint, per hard rule)
